kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتموضع (form IIq)
# أَتَمَوْضَعُ (ʔatamawḍaʕu) /ʔa.ta.maw.dˤa.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَمَوْضَعَ (tamawḍaʕa)
# أَتَمَوْضَعَ (ʔatamawḍaʕa) /ʔa.ta.maw.dˤa.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَمَوْضَعَ (tamawḍaʕa)
# أَتَمَوْضَعْ (ʔatamawḍaʕ) /ʔa.ta.maw.dˤaʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَمَوْضَعَ (tamawḍaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
